text:
liz: kicking off a small RBAC prune tomorrow AM. goal: remove console admin grants that haven't had owner proof in 90 days, and tighten KMS key bindings. canary approach: two non-prod orgs, then prod slice if green.

omar: timeline? will we touch service accounts or only human principals?

liz: both. svcacct removal will be conservative: remove role bindings but keep keys until owner confirms. svcacct owners must ack in owners-sheet within 48h or we tag for temporary de-scope.

mina: owners-sheet format? can we auto-validate a proof link? last time folks missed it.

liz: owners-sheet columns: principal, email, team, resource, proof_url, last_active. we'll run a quick script that checks proof_url is reachable (200) and last_active > 30d for humans. svcacct last_active is token-rotation date.

felix: KMS cross-account grants are spicy. if a key has external principals >0, what's the plan?

liz: rule: any external principal requires explicit owner confirmation. if owner missing -> set key policy to restricted (deny external) and create a ticket for product/security to re-evaluate before re-enabling. do NOT delete keys.

deploy-bot: alert: owners-sheet created at https://drive/repo/owners-sheet.csv by liz at 2022-06-12T09:04:12Z :white_check_mark:

omar: can we have a quick audit-log query to detect unexpected permission denials post-change?

felix: paste this; it's fast and matches our logs:
```
SELECT
  protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal,
  protoPayload.methodName AS method,
  jsonPayload.request.resource AS resource,
  COUNT(1) AS denials
FROM `company-logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_data_access_*`
WHERE protoPayload.status.code = 7
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
GROUP BY principal, method, resource
ORDER BY denials DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

mina: canary alert thresholds? we should avoid noisy paging.

liz: set a warning at >10 denials/min for a given principal in canary projects. page SRE if >50 denials/min or if any production KMS GrantDenied seen.

omar: edge-case: CI runners pinned to admin roles in canary. we should allow and track them. propose adding them to an allowlist that requires rotation plan within 7 days.

liz: agreed. add allowlist column in owners-sheet and require rotation ticket link.

kate: who is fallback owner to revert if canary causes outages?

liz: mina will coordinate rollbacks for the first window. if a rollback is needed, we revert bindings and attach a rollback note in owners-sheet with root cause.

felix: also capture KMS GrantDenied logs with the following sample to help triage:
```
resource.type="kms_key"
jsonPayload.event_type="KMS_GRANT_DENIED"
```
We can wire a specific alert for that.

deploy-bot: alert rule "rbac-prune-canary-denials" created by felix at 2022-06-12T09:21:00Z :white_check_mark:

mina: small ask 1 1: can we add a short pre-check list for teams getting their principals modified? list: notify, ack owner-sheet, confirm CI allowlist, and mark rollback contact.

liz: will post the pre-check template and a short runbook (including how to restore key bindings) in #eng-security before EOD. please review ASAP.

omar: ack. i'll run a sweep for ownerless SAs and send a short report before canary window.

kate: thanks all. low-risk plan, looks good.

liz: closing - we'll reconvene after canary for a 15m retro and next steps.
